scientific_integrity: The main result is proved for all admissible integers; finite enumerations are corroboration only. The foundational cardinality, conductor and nilpotency facts are credited as prior work.
scientific_limitations: The classification covers only conductor cutoffs of coprime two-generated numerical semigroups. The general symmetric-semigroup rigidity conjecture and other cutting points are not settled. Novelty is conditional on accessible full text and indexed records; no independent scientific audit has been performed.
title: Two invariants classify conductor quotients of two-generated numerical semigroups
